jobs.title: APAC Sanctions Officer
jobs.description:
• Handle Sanctions-related advisory and escalations, and provide subject matter expertise (SME) on core risk areas to all relevant stakeholders in APAC across all Lines of Business
• Execute the team’s day-to-day activities, including assessments of customer relationships with nexus to sanctioned countries and/or persons, transaction- and securities escalations, reputational risk reviews, drafting and negotiation of sanctions related legal clauses in collaboration with General Counsel (Legal), analysis and commenting on new regulatory and internal requirements, etc
• Dealing with significant complex Sanctions issues, requiring detailed analysis and/or external legal advice/interaction with regulators etc
• Assist with the continued effective implementation and refinement of a robust Sanctions risk and controls framework in APAC, in consultation with the Global Sanctions team
• Produce and assist with maintenance of all relevant management information, including regular and accurate reporting to Management
• Participate in regional and global projects and working groups; assist with internal audits, compliance monitoring & testing reviews
• Deliver targeted Sanctions training to ensure employees in their areas of coverage receive training commensurate with the level of risk associated with their job responsibilities

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
Are you interested in starting your journey as a Product Manager and working closely with Operations and Technology teams? Are you passionate about improving end user experience and using data and technology— including AI — to drive meaningful operational change?
We’re looking for a Product Manager (AO) to join the Collateral Crew, specifically within the Margin & Interest Workflow pod. The pod is responsible for driving meaningful change in margin call issuance processes, leveraging AI and automation to improve accuracy, efficiency, and user experience.
You will work closely with Operations users and the collateral crew to understand pain points, support delivery of solutions, and help ensure successful rollout and adoption.

Key responsibilities would include, but are not limited to:
• Support ownership of one or more Collateral Operations products or services within the Margin & Interest Workflow pod.
• Work closely with Collateral Operations users to understand day to day margin and interest workflows and identify pain points.
• Help identify opportunities to improve efficiency, reduce risk, and enhance user experience, particularly within margin call issuance processes.
• Assist in capturing and translating stakeholder requirements into clear, structured inputs for the delivery team.
• Support demand clarification and backlog prioritization in partnership with senior Product Managers and engineering leads.
• Contribute to the development and maintenance of product backlogs, ensuring user needs are clearly articulated.
• Work with Technology teams to support delivery of solutions that leverage AI and automation to improve margin processes.
• Participate in user demos, showcases, and walkthroughs of new functionality.
• Actively support user adoption, gathering feedback and helping teams understand and embed new solutions.
• Track and communicate basic outcomes of delivered changes (e.g. usability improvements, reduced manual effort).
• Support compliance with risk, control, and security requirements by working with relevant stakeholders.
• Assist with audit or control activities by helping ensure documentation and evidence are up to date.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sei interessato a iniziare il tuo viaggio come Product Manager e lavorare a stretto contatto con i team Operations and Technology? Sei appassionato di migliorare l'esperienza degli utenti finali e di utilizzare dati e tecnologie, tra cui AI, per guidare cambiamenti operativi significativi?
Stiamo cercando un Product Manager (AO) per aderire al Crew Collaterale, specificamente all'interno del pod Margin & Interest Workflow. Il pod è responsabile della guida di cambiamenti significativi nei processi di emissione di margin call, sfruttando l'IA e l'automazione per migliorare l'accuratezza, l'efficienza e l'esperienza degli utenti.
Potrai lavorare a stretto contatto con gli utenti Operazioni e l'equipaggio collaterale per capire i punti di dolore, sostenere la consegna di soluzioni, e contribuire a garantire successo rollout e adozione.

Le responsabilità chiave includono, ma non sono limitate a:
• Sostenere la proprietà di uno o più prodotti o servizi di Operazioni Collaterali all'interno del pod Margin & Interest Workflow.
• Lavorare a stretto contatto con gli utenti delle Operazioni Collaterali per comprendere i flussi di lavoro giornalieri e di interesse e identificare i punti di dolore.
• Aiuta a identificare le opportunità per migliorare l'efficienza, ridurre il rischio e migliorare l'esperienza dell'utente, in particolare all'interno dei processi di emissione delle chiamate a margine.
• Aiutare a catturare e tradurre i requisiti delle parti interessate in input chiari e strutturati per il team di consegna.
• Sostenere la chiarificazione della domanda e la priorità del backlog in collaborazione con senior Product Manager e lead ingegneristici.
• Contribuire allo sviluppo e alla manutenzione dei backlog del prodotto, assicurando che le esigenze degli utenti siano chiaramente articolate.
• Lavorare con i team tecnologici per supportare la fornitura di soluzioni che sfruttano l'IA e l'automazione per migliorare i processi di margine.
• Partecipa alle demo degli utenti, alle vetrine e alle guide di nuova funzionalità.
• Supporta attivamente l'adozione degli utenti, raccogliendo feedback e aiutando i team a comprendere e incorporare nuove soluzioni.
• Tracciare e comunicare i risultati di base delle modifiche apportate (ad esempio miglioramenti di usabilità, riduzione dello sforzo manuale).
• Sostenere la conformità ai requisiti di rischio, controllo e sicurezza lavorando con gli stakeholder rilevanti.
• Assistere con attività di audit o controllo, aiutando a garantire la documentazione e le prove sono aggiornate.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Sind Sie daran interessiert, Ihre Reise als Produktmanager zu beginnen und eng mit Operations- und Technologieteams zusammenzuarbeiten? Sind Sie leidenschaftlich daran interessiert, die Endbenutzererfahrung zu verbessern und Daten und Technologien - einschließlich KI - zu nutzen, um sinnvolle betriebliche Veränderungen voranzutreiben?
Wir suchen einen Produktmanager (AO), der der Collateral Crew beitritt, insbesondere innerhalb des Margin & Interest Workflow-Pods. Der Pod ist dafür verantwortlich, signifikante Veränderungen in den Margin-Call-Emissionsprozessen voranzutreiben und KI und Automatisierung zu nutzen, um Genauigkeit, Effizienz und Benutzererfahrung zu verbessern.
Sie arbeiten eng mit Operations-Benutzern und der Kollateral-Crew zusammen, um Schwachstellen zu verstehen, die Bereitstellung von Lösungen zu unterstützen und eine erfolgreiche Einführung und Übernahme sicherzustellen.

Zu den wichtigsten Zuständigkeiten gehören unter anderem:
• Unterstützung des Eigentums an einem oder mehreren Collateral Operations Produkten oder Dienstleistungen innerhalb des Margin & Interest Workflow Pods.
• Arbeiten Sie eng mit Benutzern von Collateral Operations zusammen, um die täglichen Margin- und Interessen-Workflows zu verstehen und Schwachstellen zu identifizieren.
• Helfen Sie bei der Identifizierung von Möglichkeiten zur Verbesserung der Effizienz, Verringerung des Risikos und Verbesserung der Benutzererfahrung, insbesondere bei Margin-Call-Emissionsprozessen.
• Unterstützung bei der Erfassung und Übersetzung von Stakeholder-Anforderungen in klare, strukturierte Inputs für das Lieferteam.
• Unterstützung von Bedarfsklärung und Backlog-Priorisierung in Zusammenarbeit mit Senior Product Managern und Engineering Leads.
• Beitrag zur Entwicklung und Pflege von Produkt-Backlogs, um sicherzustellen, dass die Bedürfnisse der Benutzer klar artikuliert werden.
• Arbeiten Sie mit Technologieteams zusammen, um die Bereitstellung von Lösungen zu unterstützen, die KI und Automatisierung nutzen, um Margenprozesse zu verbessern.
• Beteiligen Sie sich an Benutzerdemos, Showcases und Walkthroughs neuer Funktionen.
Aktive Unterstützung der Benutzerakzeptanz, Sammlung von Feedback und Unterstützung von Teams beim Verständnis und Einbetten neuer Lösungen.
• Verfolgen und Kommunizieren grundlegender Ergebnisse der gelieferten Änderungen (z. B. Verbesserungen der Benutzerfreundlichkeit, reduzierter manueller Aufwand).
• Unterstützung der Einhaltung von Risiko-, Kontroll- und Sicherheitsanforderungen durch die Zusammenarbeit mit relevanten Stakeholdern.
• Unterstützung bei Audit- oder Kontrollaktivitäten, indem Sie sicherstellen, dass Dokumentation und Nachweise auf dem neuesten Stand sind.
descriptionByLocale.fr:

Êtes-vous passionné par l'amélioration de l'expérience utilisateur final et l'utilisation des données et de la technologie, y compris l'IA, pour susciter des changements opérationnels significatifs?
Nous recherchons un Product Manager (AO) pour rejoindre le Collatéral Crew, en particulier dans le module Margin & Interest Workflow. Le module est responsable du changement significatif des processus d'émission des appels de marge, en tirant parti de l'intelligence artificielle et de l'automatisation pour améliorer la précision, l'efficacité et l'expérience utilisateur.
Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les utilisateurs des Opérations et l'équipe collatérale pour comprendre les points de douleur, soutenir la livraison des solutions et aider à assurer le déploiement et l'adoption réussies.

Les principales responsabilités comprennent, sans s'y limiter :
• Soutenir la propriété d'un ou de plusieurs produits ou services d'Opérations Colllatérales dans le module Margin & Interest Workflow.
• Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les utilisateurs d'Opérations Collatérales pour comprendre la marge quotidienne et les flux de travail d'intérêt et identifier les points de douleur.
• Aider à identifier les possibilités d'améliorer l'efficacité, de réduire les risques et d'améliorer l'expérience des utilisateurs, en particulier dans le cadre des processus d'émission des appels de marge.
• Aider à saisir et à traduire les besoins des parties prenantes en contributions claires et structurées pour l'équipe d'exécution.
• Soutenir la clarification de la demande et la hiérarchisation de l'arriéré en partenariat avec les chefs de produit et les chefs de file en ingénierie.
• Contribuer au développement et au maintien des arriérés de produits, en veillant à ce que les besoins des utilisateurs soient clairement définis.
• Collaborer avec des équipes technologiques pour soutenir la fourniture de solutions qui tirent parti de l'intelligence artificielle et de l'automatisation pour améliorer les processus de marge.
• Participer à des démonstrations d'utilisateurs, à des vitrines et à la découverte de nouvelles fonctionnalités.
• Soutenir activement l'adoption des utilisateurs, recueillir des commentaires et aider les équipes à comprendre et à intégrer de nouvelles solutions.
• Suivre et communiquer les résultats de base des changements apportés (par exemple, amélioration de la convivialité, réduction de l'effort manuel).
• Soutenir le respect des exigences en matière de risque, de contrôle et de sécurité en travaillant avec les parties prenantes concernées.
• Aider aux activités d'audit ou de contrôle en veillant à ce que la documentation et les preuves soient à jour.

jobs.title: Product Specialist – Distribution Oversight
jobs.description:
Do you want to operate at the intersection of risk, regulation, and global fund distribution, with direct exposure to senior stakeholders and Board-level reporting?
We’re looking for a high-ownership Product Specialist to strengthen our Distribution Oversight function. This role requires a strong sense of accountability, attention to detail, and the ability to operate independently in a regulated environment.

We’re looking for a Product Specialist – Distribution Oversight to:

• Conduct onboarding and ongoing due diligence on Funds Distributors (“delegates”)
• Drive ongoing monitoring activities (e.g. KPIs, control reviews, deep dives, and onsite assessments), ensuring consistency, quality, and timely execution
• Perform risk assessments of delegates, clearly identifying issues, proposing pragmatic remediation actions, and following them through to closure
• Produce high-quality reporting for senior management and Boards of Directors, ensuring accuracy, clarity, and strong documentation standards
• Challenge and enhance the control framework, proactively identifying gaps, inefficiencies, and improvement opportunities
• Ensure compliance with applicable regulatory frameworks (e.g. AML, UCITS/AIF requirements) across multiple jurisdictions
• Actively contributes to process simplification and automation, identifying opportunities to leverage tools (e.g. Copilot, Excel automation, data analytics) to improve efficiency and control quality

descriptionByLocale.it:
Vuoi operare all'intersezione del rischio, della regolamentazione e della distribuzione globale dei fondi, con un'esposizione diretta agli stakeholder senior e alle relazioni a livello di Consiglio?
Stiamo cercando uno specialista di prodotti ad alta proprietà per rafforzare la nostra funzione di controllo di distribuzione. Questo ruolo richiede un forte senso di responsabilità, attenzione ai dettagli, e la capacità di operare in modo indipendente in un ambiente regolamentato.

Stiamo cercando uno specialista del prodotto – Oversight di distribuzione per:

• Condurre a bordo e in corso due diligence sui distributori di fondi (“delegati”)
• Guidare attività di monitoraggio in corso (ad esempio KPI, recensioni di controllo, immersioni profonde e valutazioni in loco), garantendo coerenza, qualità e esecuzione tempestiva
• Esegui le valutazioni dei rischi dei delegati, identificando chiaramente le questioni, proponendo azioni pragmatiche di bonifica e seguendole fino alla chiusura
• Produrre report di alta qualità per senior management e consigli di amministrazione, garantendo precisione, chiarezza e forti standard di documentazione
• Sfidare e migliorare il quadro di controllo, individuare attivamente lacune, inefficienze e opportunità di miglioramento
• Assicurare il rispetto dei quadri normativi applicabili (ad esempio requisiti AML, UCITS/AIF) in più giurisdizioni
• Contribuisce attivamente al processo di semplificazione e automazione, identificando le opportunità di sfruttare gli strumenti (ad esempio Copilota, Automazione Excel, Data Analytics) per migliorare l'efficienza e la qualità di controllo
descriptionByLocale.de:
Möchten Sie an der Schnittstelle von Risiko, Regulierung und globaler Fondsverteilung tätig sein, mit direktem Engagement für leitende Stakeholder und Berichterstattung auf Vorstandsebene?
Wir suchen einen High-Ownership Product Specialist, um unsere Distribution Oversight-Funktion zu stärken. Diese Rolle erfordert ein starkes Gefühl der Rechenschaftspflicht, Liebe zum Detail und die Fähigkeit, in einem regulierten Umfeld unabhängig zu arbeiten.

Wir suchen einen Produktspezialisten – Distribution Oversight für:

• Durchführung von Onboarding und laufender Due Diligence bei Fondsvertreibern („Delegierte)
• Laufende Monitoring-Aktivitäten (z. B. KPIs, Kontrollüberprüfungen, Deep Dives und Onsite-Bewertungen) fördern, um Konsistenz, Qualität und zeitnahe Ausführung zu gewährleisten
• Durchführung von Risikobewertungen von Delegierten, klare Identifizierung von Problemen, Vorschlag pragmatischer Sanierungsmaßnahmen und deren Weiterverfolgung bis zur Schließung
• Erstellung einer qualitativ hochwertigen Berichterstattung für die Geschäftsleitung und den Verwaltungsrat, um Genauigkeit, Klarheit und strenge Dokumentationsstandards zu gewährleisten
• Herausforderung und Verbesserung des Kontrollrahmens, proaktive Identifizierung von Lücken, Ineffizienzen und Verbesserungsmöglichkeiten
• Gewährleistung der Einhaltung der geltenden regulatorischen Rahmenbedingungen (z. B. AML, UCITS/AIF-Anforderungen) in mehreren Ländern
• Trägt aktiv zur Prozessvereinfachung und -automatisierung bei und identifiziert Möglichkeiten zur Nutzung von Tools (z. B. Copilot, Excel-Automatisierung, Datenanalyse), um die Effizienz und die Kontrollqualität zu verbessern
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Voulez-vous opérer à l'intersection des risques, de la réglementation et de la répartition mondiale des fonds, avec une exposition directe aux principaux intervenants et aux rapports du Conseil?
Nous sommes à la recherche d'un spécialiste en produits à forte propriété pour renforcer notre fonction de surveillance de la distribution. Ce rôle exige un sens fort de la responsabilité, une attention aux détails et la capacité d'opérer de façon indépendante dans un environnement réglementé.

Nous cherchons un spécialiste des produits – Surveillance de la distribution pour :

• Mener des opérations d'embarquement et de diligence raisonnable sur les distributeurs de fonds (délégations)
• Mener des activités de surveillance continue (p. ex., ICR, examens de contrôle, plongées profondes et évaluations sur place), assurer la cohérence, la qualité et l'exécution en temps opportun
• Effectuer des évaluations des risques des délégués, identifier clairement les problèmes, proposer des mesures d'assainissement pragmatiques et les suivre jusqu'à la clôture
• Produire des rapports de haute qualité à l'intention des cadres supérieurs et des conseils d'administration, en veillant à l'exactitude, à la clarté et à des normes de documentation rigoureuses
• Défier et améliorer le cadre de contrôle, identifier les lacunes, les inefficacités et les possibilités d'amélioration
• Veiller au respect des cadres réglementaires applicables (par exemple la LAM, les exigences des OPCVM/IFA) dans plusieurs juridictions
• contribue activement à la simplification et à l'automatisation des processus, en identifiant les possibilités de tirer parti des outils (par exemple copilote, automatisation Excel, analyse de données) pour améliorer l'efficacité et la qualité du contrôle

descriptionByLocale.it: In qualità di consulente mutuo remoto, sei il primo punto di contatto per i nuovi clienti che si trovano ad affrontare una delle decisioni finanziarie più importanti della loro vita: il finanziamento della propria casa. Together with a dedicated team and state-of-the-art digital tools, you will make the mortgage advice of tomorrow successful. Your tasks: • You advise new customers on mortgage transactions - flexibly, digitally and always with an open ear for their individual needs. • You actively acquire new customers in the Affluent segment and build long-term relationships. • You conduct financing discussions, check loan requests and develop tailor-made financing solutions. • You cooperate with external finders (e.g. real estate agents, agents) to generate and successfully close leads. • You ensure that all regulatory requirements and compliance standards are adhered to.

jobs.title: Head of Tax, Greater China
jobs.description:
Do you have a tax background in financial services or a chartered accountancy or law firm? Do you have a knack for breaking down complex issues to reach clear and concise conclusions? Are you able to interact with senior stakeholders and regulators? We’re looking for someone with tax expertise to help us:

• provide tax advice to the business divisions including Investment Bank, Asset Management and Global Wealth Management across UBS in Hong Kong, China, Taiwan and Korea regarding new business and change initiatives and complex transactions
• monitor tax reform issues impacting UBS
• interact effectively with senior management and staff across the different areas within the organisation
• manage relationships with tax authorities
• review tax effect accounting calculations and workpapers. This includes annual statutory reporting, and quarterly local and Swiss reporting
• work with the external service provider and Finance in supporting the annual corporate income tax process. Review the annual corporate income tax returns for all legal entities, including all disclosures, for the legal entities in jurisdictions under your responsibility
• review, update and compile the income tax manuals as required
• review the annual transfer pricing documentation for the jurisdictions under your responsibility
• review the annual local files under country by country reporting rules
• provide technical tax support into the wider APAC tax team where required, including supporting sign off to APAC Regional Tax for business advisory and new business initiatives

jobs.description:
"The SAP S/4HANA Finance Functional Delivery Lead supports the delivery of core SAP S/4HANA Finance capabilities within the ampliFi program, with primary accountability across General Ledger (GL), Group Reporting (GR), consolidation, reporting, and the broader Finance & Controlling (FI/CO) landscape. The role is responsible for driving disciplined execution across functional design, business validation, testing readiness, and production transition, ensuring that finance processes, close activities, and reporting outcomes are delivered in line with UBS accounting principles, governance, and control standards.
The role partners closely with Finance, Group Reporting and Consolidation teams, Data, Integration, and Technology stakeholders and acts as a functional representative for S/4HANA Finance within the delivery. It ensures that business requirements are translated into robust, well‑controlled finance solutions aligned with the target architecture and capable of supporting stable close, consolidation, and reporting cycles.

Key Responsibilities
- Support end‑to‑end functional delivery for assigned SAP S/4HANA Finance workstreams covering General Ledger, Group Reporting, consolidation, and reporting within the ampliFi finance stack, with clear ownership of outcomes.
- Contribute to and review functional designs and configurations across FI/CO to ensure alignment with agreed solution architecture, accounting principles, and reporting requirements.
- Ensure that S/4HANA Finance solutions support accurate posting, close, consolidation, and reporting outcomes, including integration with upstream subledgers and downstream reporting consumers.
- Develop and maintain delivery plans covering functional scope, milestones, dependencies, and impacts across S/4HANA Finance integration points and reporting consumption.
- Proactively manage risks, issues, and dependencies (RAID), with a focus on financial accuracy, close stability, consolidation integrity, and regulatory expectations, escalating where required.
- Coordinate day‑to‑day delivery across Finance, Group Reporting, Data, Integration, Testing, and Deployment teams to ensure coherent end‑to‑end execution across close, consolidation, and reporting cycles.
- Ensure adherence to agreed delivery standards, accounting principles, design decisions, and change control processes across the S/4HANA Finance scope.
- Support SIT and UAT execution from a functional perspective, including validation of close and consolidation scenarios, assessment of defects based on finance impact, and support for business sign‑off.
- Assist with production readiness and cutover preparation, focusing on stability of financial close and consolidation cycles, accuracy of balances and reports, and smooth transition to business‑as‑usual operations post go‑live.
"

Il ruolo è responsabile della guida dell'esecuzione disciplinata attraverso il design funzionale, la validazione aziendale, la prontezza dei test e la transizione di produzione, assicurando che i processi finanziari, le attività strette e i risultati di report siano forniti in linea con i principi contabili UBS, la governance e gli standard di controllo.

Assicura che i requisiti aziendali siano tradotti in soluzioni finanziarie robuste e ben controllate allineate all'architettura di destinazione e in grado di supportare cicli di chiusura, consolidamento e reporting stabili.

Principali responsabilità
- Supporta la consegna funzionale end-to-end per i flussi di lavoro SAP S/4HANA Finance assegnati che coprono General Ledger, Group Reporting, consolidamento e reporting all'interno dello stack di finanza di amplificazione, con chiara proprietà dei risultati.
- Contribuire e rivedere progetti e configurazioni funzionali in tutta la FI/CO per garantire l'allineamento con l'architettura di soluzioni concordate, principi contabili e requisiti di reportistica.
- Assicurarsi che le soluzioni S/4HANA Finance supportino risultati di posting, close, consolidamento e reporting accurati, tra cui l'integrazione con subledger a monte e i consumatori di reporting a valle.
- Sviluppare e mantenere i piani di consegna che coprono la portata funzionale, pietre miliari, dipendenze e impatti attraverso i punti di integrazione S/4HANA Finance e il consumo di reportistica.
- Gestione attiva dei rischi, dei problemi e delle dipendenze (RAID), con particolare attenzione all'accuratezza finanziaria, alla stretta stabilità, all'integrità del consolidamento e alle aspettative normative, all'aumento ove necessario.
- Coordinare la consegna giornaliera tra i team Finance, Group Reporting, Data, Integration, Testing e Deployment per garantire una coerente esecuzione end-to-end attraverso cicli di chiusura, consolidamento e reporting.
- Assicurare l'adesione a standard di consegna concordati, principi contabili, decisioni di progettazione e processi di controllo di cambiamento nel campo di applicazione S/4HANA Finance.
- Supporta l'esecuzione SIT e UAT da una prospettiva funzionale, compresa la convalida di scenari di chiusura e consolidamento, la valutazione di difetti basati sull'impatto finanziario e il supporto per il sign-off aziendale.
- Assistere con la prontezza di produzione e la preparazione di taglio, concentrandosi sulla stabilità dei cicli di chiusura finanziaria e di consolidamento, l'accuratezza dei bilanci e dei rapporti, e la transizione fluida alle operazioni di business-as-usual post go-live.
"
